#!/bin/sh
# realmcradle-managed Squad server — generated by provision().
# This server's own files: <ROOT>/installs/squad/realmcradle-servers/test
. <ROOT>/secrets.conf
python3 - "<ROOT>/installs/squad/SquadGame/ServerConfig/Rcon.cfg" "$GAME_SERVER_PASSWORD" "$GAME_ADMIN_PASSWORD" <<'SYNC'
import re, sys
p, join, admin = sys.argv[1:4]
t = open(p, encoding="utf-8", newline="").read()     # keep its line endings
bom = "\ufeff" if t.startswith("\ufeff") else ""
t = t[len(bom):]
for key, val in (
    ('Password', admin),
):
    line = key + '=' + val
    pattern = r'(?m)^' + re.escape(key + '=') + r'[^\r\n]*'
    if re.search(pattern, t):
        t = re.sub(pattern, lambda m: line, t)
    else:
        pass   # not in the file: left out
open(p, "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="").write(bom + t)
SYNC
python3 - 21114 "$GAME_ADMIN_PASSWORD" "$GAME_SERVER_PASSWORD" <<'LOCK' &
import socket, struct, sys, time
port, admin, join = int(sys.argv[1]), sys.argv[2], sys.argv[3]
def pkt(i, kind, body):
    b = struct.pack("<ii", i, kind) + body.encode() + b"\0\0"
    return struct.pack("<i", len(b)) + b
for _ in range(240):            # the console opens when the first map has loaded
    time.sleep(5)
    try:
        s = socket.create_connection(("127.0.0.1", port), timeout=5)
        s.sendall(pkt(1, 3, admin)); time.sleep(1); s.recv(4096)
        s.sendall(pkt(2, 2, "AdminSetServerPassword " + join)); time.sleep(1); s.recv(4096)
        s.close(); break
    except OSError:
        pass
LOCK
cd "<ROOT>/installs/squad/" || exit 1
exec ./SquadGame/Binaries/Linux/SquadGameServer SquadGame Port=7787 QueryPort=27165 beaconport=15000 FIXEDMAXPLAYERS=40 RANDOM=NONE -log
